serviceName: Root domain (A/AAAA) with ownership verification, verification-variable variant
description: Points a zone's root (apex) at a SaaS product's published addresses via one A record and, optionally, one AAAA record, and proves ownership with one constrained TXT record at a fixed host. Never a CNAME at the apex. Used by DoDomain (domain-connect-as-a-service) on behalf of its integrator applications; the addresses and the verification value are the only variables. Apply with groupId=apex-a,verify to omit the AAAA record. Variant of dodomain.io/apex-a-with-verification, identical except that its verification variable is named verification instead of token, for DNS providers that reserve the token parameter name.
variableDescription: ipv4 = the IPv4 address the integrator application publishes for the root domain; ipv6 = the IPv6 address (group apex-aaaa, optional); verification = the opaque verification token minted by DoDomain for this connect session.
